objectives.core_josie_recovery: Restore the minimum durable state, authority, configuration, source, secrets-by-reference, and service state needed for functional operation on replacement hardware.
objectives.full_data_recovery: After core operation, restore archives, history, bulk datasets, media, cold models, and other economically useful storage. No completion time is asserted until attended throughput and volume are measured.

entries.capability: Git source, branches, private forks, and acceptance tests
entries.discovery_rule: repository remotes and all required branches/tags; private forks UNVERIFIED
entries.verification_method: clone into isolation; enumerate refs; run documented tests
entries.notes: Working tree is not a backup; remote/private-fork coverage is unknown.

entries.capability: Canonical database and durable application state
entries.verification_method: SQLite integrity check on isolated restored copy
entries.restore_method: restore a consistent SQLite backup while services are stopped
entries.notes: Existence observed in Phase 0A; contents, freshness, WAL consistency, and restorability not verified.

entries.capability: Receipts, execution history, authorization records, and private worker state
entries.verification_method: metadata and checksum comparison without printing contents
entries.notes: Contents and delegation lock/receipts must not be accessed during preparation.

entries.capability: Configuration, identity, constitution, deployment definitions, and model configuration
entries.discovery_rule: config; deploy; docs/identity; docs/constitution; .env and deploy/.env.services by presence only
entries.verification_method: manifested hashes for non-secrets; secret presence and recovery test without disclosure
entries.restore_method: restore files and permissions; inject secrets from approved escrow
entries.notes: Secret values are intentionally absent from this manifest.

entries.capability: Open WebUI and n8n persistent state
entries.discovery_rule: Docker named volumes josie_open_webui_data and josie_n8n_data
entries.verification_method: isolated volume restore with matching image/schema and application health checks
entries.restore_method: restore archive into new isolated volumes before promotion
entries.notes: Actual volume health, images, encryption coverage, and archive parity are UNVERIFIED.

entries.capability: Windows recovery, startup tasks, firewall/service settings, Tailscale, native Ollama configuration
entries.discovery_rule: attended Windows inventory; exact export locations UNVERIFIED
entries.verification_method: attended inventory and replacement-host recovery checklist
entries.restore_method: recreate from verified exports/documentation with Dustin approval
entries.notes: Preparation does not query or change services.

entries.discovery_rule: approved credential manager or encrypted escrow; location UNVERIFIED
entries.verification_method: Dustin confirms recovery path and performs non-disclosing authentication test
entries.restore_method: interactive recovery from approved encrypted source
entries.notes: Never record values, keys, tokens, or passwords in receipts.

entries.capability: Archives, historical data, large datasets, media, cold models, evidence, and proposals
entries.discovery_rule: D:/Josie-Storage and any external storage; mapping and contents UNVERIFIED
entries.verification_method: attended inventory, sampled hashes, capacity and coverage comparison
entries.restore_method: restore after core service, prioritized by value and dependency
entries.notes: Models may be marked rebuildable only after provenance and download availability are verified.

entries.discovery_rule: physical or offsite target selected by Dustin; UNVERIFIED
entries.verification_method: physical confirmation plus isolated fixture round trip
entries.restore_method: attach/unlock attended, then restore into isolation
entries.notes: No external target is assumed present or healthy.
